verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust/Axum web framework. Its ecosystem could plausibly ship webhook event subscriptions, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The 'event handlers' it mentions are client-side island interactivity, not webhooks. Routing primitives could only be used to build webhook endpoints oneself, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
